utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: I heard it's next Saturday, 2 to 4 PM. Do you know more?

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Oh, I think there might be some confusion—it's actually this Saturday at 9 AM at the community center on Elm Street, not next Saturday.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Wait, really? I must have heard wrong. Thanks for clearing that up!

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Hey Vik! Are you coming to the repair drive this Saturday at the community center on Elm Street? It starts at 9 AM.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Yeah, I'm actually the one organizing it! Could you help me spread the word?

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Absolutely, Vik! I've already been telling everyone I see. Count me in to help spread the word!

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Hey Gus, I'm a bit late to the loop, but I hear there's a repair drive this Saturday? What's that all about?

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Yeah, it's happening this Saturday! Folks bring in old appliances, and we fix 'em for free. I'm bringing my toolkit, so let me know if you need anything.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: That sounds great, Gus! I might have a broken toaster I could bring along. What time does it start?

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: It's Sunday, not Saturday. At the community center from 10 to 4.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh, Sunday! I keep mixing up the days. Thanks, Leo, I'll be there from 10 to 4.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Good. See you there.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: A repair drive? You sure that's not just some scheme?

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: It's legitimate, Kira. Saturday at 9 AM at the Elm Street community center. I've got the details straight.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Saturday, 9 AM, Elm Street community center, huh? Well, I guess I'll believe it when I see it.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Hey Cleo, just a heads up—the repair drive today is closing the main road near the school from 2 to 4 PM, so we might need to plan for a later pickup or use the side entrance.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Wait, Faye—I thought the repair drive is next Saturday, not today. Are you sure about the date?

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Actually, I double-checked and it's definitely today, from 2 to 4. So we need to adjust pickup.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Good, I'll be there at 9 with my broken toaster.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Perfect, I'll see you at the community center on Elm Street.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Great, I'll see you there.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Bo, I'm confused—some say Saturday, others Sunday. Which day is the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: I thought it was Saturday, but Faye said it's today with a road closure. I'm not sure anymore.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Let's check the community center notice—I remember seeing Sunday on the flyer.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Hey Ira, I heard about the repair drive on Saturday. Can I lend a hand?

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Hey Sam, that's really kind of you! It's this Saturday at 9 AM at the community center. We can use all the help we can get.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Great, I'll be there! Is there anything specific you need me to bring or help with?

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Oh, so you're organizing it? I'll try to come on Saturday.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Great, hope to see you there. It's at 9 AM at the community center on Elm Street.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Okay, I'll mark my calendar. Thanks, Eli.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh right, the repair drive. I keep forgetting about that.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Yeah, me too. Saturday morning, at the community center, I think.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Saturday morning, right. I'll try to remember this time.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Hey Rosa, are you planning to come to the repair drive this Saturday at the community center? I heard they're fixing household items.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Oh Tess, I appreciate you checking! Actually, the repair drive is on Sunday at the community center, not Saturday. Hope you can still make it!

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Oh really? I could have sworn I heard Saturday at 9, but maybe I mixed it up. I'll double-check the flyer and let you know!

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Oh, Vik! I was just checking our supply list for the repair drive next Saturday. Do you know if we're short on anything?

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Wait, Cleo, the repair drive is this Saturday at 9 AM at the community center, not next Saturday! And I think we could use more screws and maybe some duct tape.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Oh, you're right! I got the date mixed up. I'll update the list and make sure we have extra screws and duct tape.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh, right, the repair drive? It's this Saturday at 9 AM at the Elm Street community center, I think.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Wait, I thought it was next Saturday from 2 to 4 PM—are you sure it's this Saturday at 9 AM?

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Hmm, maybe I mixed it up. I did just glance at the flyer quickly.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Yeah, I'm still planning on it, but Faye said something about it being today... I'm a bit confused now.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: It's Sunday, not today.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Wait, so is it Saturday or Sunday? I need to check the flyer again.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Hey Eli, are you planning to go to the repair drive this Saturday at 9?

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Yes, I'll be there at 9 at the community center on Elm Street.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Great, I'll see you there! What are you planning to bring to fix?

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Hey Hana, the repair drive is this Saturday at 9 AM at the community center. You planning to go?

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Yes, I've got it in my calendar. Are you planning to bring anything to repair?

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: I think I'll bring that old toaster that's been acting up. Maybe someone can fix it.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: The repair drive is today, closing the main road from 2 to 4. For pickup at 3, let's use the side entrance to avoid delays.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Wait, I thought the repair drive was Sunday at the community center. Are they doing a different one today?

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: No, this is a separate road repair near the school, not the community center event. It's definitely today from 2 to 4.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Oh, a repair drive? I haven't heard about it yet. What's that all about?

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: It's on Saturday at 9 AM at the community center on Elm Street. Everyone's bringing tools to fix stuff together.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Sounds great, I'll try to make it. Do I need to bring any specific tools?

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Hey Kira, I heard about the repair drive next Saturday. I've got a bunch of tools we can use if needed.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: A repair drive, huh? You're sure it's legit and not just a way to get folks to turn over their stuff for free?

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Hey, I get the caution, but Tess mentioned it's a community thing—they're just fixing stuff for free. I trust her.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Hey Jules, have you heard about the repair drive this Saturday at the community center? It's at 9 AM!

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Yeah, I heard about it from Vik! I'm helping spread the word. Can you help too?

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Absolutely! Let's get everyone involved. I'll tell the folks on Maple Street.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Hey Tess, have you heard about the repair drive this Saturday at 9 AM at the community center? I was thinking of helping out.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Yes, that's right! Saturday at 9 at the community center on Elm Street. I'll be there with some old toasters to fix up.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Great, I'll bring my broken drill. See you there!

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: What time is the repair drive on Saturday again?

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Oh, Oren, actually it's on Sunday, not Saturday. It's at the community center. Does that work for you?

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh, it's Sunday! Thanks, Rosa. I'll be there. What time does it start?

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Hi Uli, are you planning to go to the repair drive this Saturday?

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: I... I'm not sure yet. I've had a lot on my mind.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: It's okay to be unsure. Do you want to talk about it?
